About this backdrop ↓
W
Historic Miami-speaking people

Wea

Wea communities lived along the Wabash River in what is now Indiana. The Indiana Historical Bureau documents a village near present-day Terre Haute by the late 1700s.

Selected reading

01

Wea communities on the Wabash

The Indiana Historical Bureau describes Wea settlements along the Wabash. Its marker notes explain that some early records use broader names that do not specify which Miami-speaking group was present.

Read the sources [1] Indiana Historical Bureau

02

The Confederated Peorias

The Peoria Tribe’s history identifies the Wea among the peoples who united in the Confederated Peorias in 1854.

Read the sources [2] Peoria Tribe of Indians of Oklahoma
